figures.name: Ra

ability.name: Solar Barque
ability.description: Heal all allies for 3; grant immunity to dark for 1 turn as Ra sails through.

figures.description: Supreme sun god who sails his barque across the sky by day and through the underworld each night.

figures.name: Osiris

ability.name: Lord of the Dead
ability.description: Resurrect one fallen ally with full HP; that ally gains the 'undying' tag.

figures.description: God of resurrection and the afterlife who was murdered by Set, reassembled by Isis and reborn as king of the dead.

figures.name: Isis

ability.name: Wings of Isis
ability.description: Negate one attack against any ally; grant that ally +3 magic for 2 turns.

figures.description: Most powerful magician in the Egyptian pantheon who resurrected Osiris and protected the infant Horus.

figures.name: Horus

ability.name: Eye of Horus
ability.description: Deal 7 damage to one enemy; restore 3 HP to this card.

figures.description: Falcon-headed sky god who avenged his father Osiris by defeating Set, becoming the divine model for all pharaohs.

figures.name: Set

ability.name: Desert Storm
ability.description: Deal 4 damage to all enemies; 50% chance to discard their top buff.

figures.description: Red-haired god of chaos and the desert whose violent energy both threatens and protects the cosmic order.

figures.name: Anubis

ability.name: Feather of Ma'at
ability.description: Weigh one enemy's heart: if their power exceeds their wisdom, deal 5 damage.

figures.description: Jackal-headed god of embalming who guides souls through the underworld and oversees the weighing of the heart.

figures.name: Thoth

ability.name: Divine Scribing
ability.description: Copy and store one enemy ability permanently for your side.

figures.description: Ibis-headed god of wisdom and writing who recorded divine knowledge, settled divine disputes and measured time.

figures.name: Sekhmet

ability.name: Eye of Destruction
ability.description: Deal 5 damage to all enemies; then heal all allies for 2 if Sekhmet is calmed.

figures.description: Lioness war goddess whose bloodlust nearly destroyed humanity until Ra tricked her with red-dyed beer.

figures.name: Hathor

ability.name: Golden Sistrum
ability.description: Remove all debuffs from all allies; grant +2 magic to all goddess allies.

figures.description: Joyous cow-goddess of love, music and beauty who greets the dead and suckles pharaohs with divine milk.

figures.name: Ptah

ability.name: Word of Creation
ability.description: Create one copy of any ally card at half stats for 2 turns.

figures.description: Creator god of Memphis who spoke the world into existence through divine speech — the first logos theology.

figures.name: Bastet

ability.name: Cat's Grace
ability.description: All allies gain +3 speed; enemy cannot use area-of-effect attacks this turn.

figures.description: Gentle cat goddess who protects homes, women and children, fierce when her family is threatened.

figures.name: Sobek

ability.name: Nile Surge
ability.description: Deal 5 damage and drag enemy to front row; cannot be blocked.

figures.description: Crocodile god of the Nile whose ferocious power both threatens and fertilizes the land.

figures.name: Nut

ability.name: Stellar Canopy
ability.description: Grant all allies +2 defense; star and sky attacks deal +2 bonus damage.

figures.description: Sky goddess who arches her body over the earth, swallowing the sun each evening and birthing it each dawn.

figures.name: Geb

ability.name: Earthquake Laugh
ability.description: When this card laughs, deal 3 damage to all enemies and shake loose 2 debuffs.

figures.description: Earth god whose laughter causes earthquakes; the green plants that grow from his back are his joy.

figures.name: Apophis

ability.name: Swallow the Sun
ability.description: Negate all light and sun abilities for 2 turns; deal 4 damage to all allies of Ra.

figures.description: Monstrous chaos serpent that attacks the solar barque every night in the underworld in eternal failed rebellion.

figures.name: Khepri

ability.name: Scarab's Roll
ability.description: Transform one ally: change their type and grant +3 to their highest stat.

figures.description: Scarab-headed god of the morning sun who rolls the disc of dawn across the horizon each day.

figures.name: Nephthys

ability.name: Lamentation Song
ability.description: When any ally falls, restore 3 HP to all remaining allies from grief-power.

figures.description: Shadow sister of Isis who guards the dead and whose wailing with Isis reassembled Osiris from his scattered pieces.

figures.name: Ammit

ability.name: Heart Devourer
ability.description: Permanently destroy one enemy card that fails a wisdom check (wisdom below 5).

figures.description: Part lion, part hippo, part crocodile — the Devourer of Hearts who destroys souls found unworthy at judgment.

figures.name: Khnum

ability.name: Divine Potter
ability.description: Shape one ally: grant them +2 to any two stats of your choice.

figures.description: Ram-headed potter god who fashions humans and their ka souls on his divine wheel at the source of the Nile.

figures.name: Bes

ability.name: Fearsome Dance
ability.description: Frighten all dark spirits: dark enemies lose 2 power for 1 turn.

figures.description: Fierce lion-dwarf god who protects mothers in childbirth, wards off evil spirits and guards sleeping children.
